B.text: For this choropleth, if the printed caption applies uniformly to all state fills, darker state color encodes a higher true incidence value; therefore the darkest state on the shared map has the highest incidence and should be routed to the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.
B.conditions: The caption “darker color means higher true value” governs all displayed state fills, and the task’s highest-incidence criterion uses that encoded incidence value.
